title: Today tab: rebuilt from the independent review

steps.headline: Start here is now the top card drawn large, with the same label and buttons as its row.
steps.changed: "Project skills & tools" carries its label (Needs your look), its tags (areas, 1 chat, both pull requests, Unsaved changes) and the same three buttons every row has: Open, ⋯, and the filled Review. The "Other options" line is gone.
steps.notice: Below it, Needs you now holds three rows, each with its own label and a filled button that matches it.

steps.path: Today → Needs you, ⋯ opened on Sync safety
steps.headline: One label decides each row's main button; Pause… and Close… are the only stop words.
steps.changed: Checks failing → Fix failing checks. Needs your look → Review. Ready to merge → Merge to master. Working → Join chat. Hold, Drop it, Set aside and Wrap up are gone; the ⋯ menu holds Pause… and Close…. Pointing at a label says why: "Ready to merge: reviewed and its checks pass; only the merge is left. That's why this row offers Merge to master."
steps.notice: The 7 failing dependency updates and the 10 leftover copies left Needs you; a copy that belongs to a piece of work is now an "Unsaved changes" tag on that row.
steps.risk: The Working label means "a chat touched it today" on this mockup; the real version shows it only while a chat is actually running.

steps.path: Today → Everything else → Helper agents → Open
steps.headline: Open shows every chat that worked on a piece of work, and lets you start another on it.
steps.changed: Helper agents opens in place: its progress (done, blocked), then its 3 chats newest first, each with what it achieved or "No summary saved", an Open chat button each, and "Start another chat on this card". Then its screens.
steps.notice: Until work cards exist, a "chat" here is a separate copy of the work, named as it is on disk; results show only where something was written down.

steps.path: Today → Everything else (was Waiting), scrolled to its end
steps.headline: "Waiting" becomes "Everything else": no finish line, idle, then paused, each row saying which.
steps.changed: Each row has the same layout: name and label, one line, a full-width line of tags with the date at the far right. Paused work comes last and says why ("Paused because: known regressions…"). One date style everywhere.
steps.notice: The notes-only copies moved out to Tidy up.

steps.headline: Housekeeping gets its own folded section, away from the decisions.
steps.changed: Three jobs: 7 automatic dependency updates (Try all seven), 4 leftover copies with no work attached (Save as backup branches), 4 copies holding only notes (Keep the notes, close the copies). The automatic clean-up line stays at the foot.
steps.notice: Nothing in Tidy up changes the app.

steps.headline: At phone width, the buttons drop under the text and the tags scroll sideways.
steps.changed: Each row stacks: name, label, line, then the three buttons at the right, then the tags with the date.
steps.notice: The tags line cuts off at the edge; it scrolls sideways.
steps.risk: No fade marks the cut-off edge of the tags line yet.
